news.headline: What Is Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Gaining From Its First CE Mark In Gynecology?
news.summary: Intuitive Surgical (NasdaqGS:ISRG) received the world's first CE mark for transvaginal gynecologic procedures using its da Vinci SP system. The approval expands the da Vinci SP platform's labeled use in Europe to include transvaginal access for gynecologic surgery.
